text: Trying to load the Qwen3 .mlmodelc via objc2-core-ml. Hitting a confusing error about attention_mask shape.
cargo run -p mci-llama-coreml --example load. Error: MLMultiArray shape mismatch — expected [1, 2048], got [1, 512].
Reading the MLMultiArray docs. The shape parameter takes NSNumber array — am I passing the right dtype?
Tried Int32 instead of Int64 for the shape. Same error.
Pinged ML eng: any idea why attention_mask shape would be wrong? Sent the error trace.
Tried loading the model in coremltools Python to inspect the spec. Worked: input shape really is [1, 2048].
Wait — the Python tool was loading a different .mlmodelc than the Rust code. Two model files in the directory.
Re-ran cargo with the corrected path. Same shape mismatch error. Still stuck.
ML eng responded — said the conversion script might emit a 512-len variant for the prefill model. Will check tomorrow.
Posted end-of-day: still blocked on Qwen3 Core ML load. Pairing with ML eng tomorrow.
